h: Shabbos Unites Awe Love Torah and Complete Teshuvah

p: In the Ra'aya Mehemna on this parshah
(זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קכב, ב – קכג, א)
"Teshuvah: the hei shall return to the vav;
דְּאָת ה׳ אִיהוּ וִידּוּי דְּבָרִים וְכוּלֵּי
for the letter hei is the confession in words, etc.
And it is the breath that goes out and comes in
וְהוּא עַל רֵישֵׁיהּ דְּבַר נָשׁ וְכוּלֵּי
and it is upon a person's head, etc.
And concerning this image of the letter hei
מַתָּנָה טוֹבָה יֵשׁ לִי בְּבֵית גְּנָזַי
'I have a good gift in My treasure house,
And when this rests upon them,
and through it the toiling soul
which is called a servant, etc.
וְדָא אִיהוּ עַל רֵישֵׁיהּ דְּבַר נָשׁ
and this is upon a person's head,
to fear the Holy One, blessed be He, etc.
of the Holy One, blessed be He, enters, etc.
ו׳ אִיהוּ עַל רֵישֵׁיהּ דְּבַר נָשׁ
The vav is upon a person's head,
And through this, that there will be in you
the fear, the love and the Torah,
the vav will return to the hei,
which is the work of Creation,
and through it you will have rest from everything,
and through it 'He rested and was refreshed,'
and in it yud-hei-vav are included;
the completion of all is in it, etc."
Now they raised a question about this
in the gloss on the holy Zohar:
that the letters yud-hei of the Name
and from Chochmah branches out the aspect of love;
while Binah, from which judgments are aroused,
yet here the Ra'aya Mehemna says the reverse:
that from the letter yud fear enters,
and from the letter hei love enters.
that is fixed in the souls of Yisrael
that is rooted in the souls of Yisrael;
and that is what is called Knesses Yisrael,
the aspect of the Kingship of Heaven,
and corresponding to it is the Name Adnus,
"And if I am a Master, where is My fear?"
And the main hold of faith
is in the attribute of Keser,
as it says in Pesach Eliyahu
it is the crown of Kingship."
We have already spoken of this:
that the Torah begins with the letter beis,
that is, from the aspect of "the beginning of wisdom,"
and this is the first contraction
of the revelation of the Ten Utterances,
Even though it does not say explicitly
in the creation of the darkness
is the being of the first contraction;
which is the nullification of comprehension;
therefore "And He said" is not said of it.
However, there is yet a level
to the point that there applies to it
not even that of nullified comprehension
and that is the aspect of the letter aleph
And that is the aspect of
רֵאשִׁית חָכְמָה יִרְאַת ה׳ (תְּהִלִּים קיא, י)
"The beginning of wisdom is the fear of Hashem" (Tehillim 111:10);
and it is the level of the letter aleph
שֶׁל אָנֹכִי ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ (שְׁמוֹת כ, ב)
with which the Ten Commandments begin.
And as is known on this
from the Ramban, of blessed memory,
was not said in the language of a command,
faith in the Divine was fixed
in the collective souls of Yisrael,
but only through being bound to the root
And with this are borne out
the words of the Ra'aya Mehemna cited above,
that from the letter yud fear enters
and that is the aspect of
"The beginning of wisdom is the fear of Hashem,"
above the head and the mind,
And as it says in the Shulchan Aruch
at the beginning of Orach Chaim (1:1)
עַל שִׁוִּיתִי ה׳ לְנֶגְדִּי תָמִיד וְכוּלֵּי
on "I have set Hashem before me always" (Tehillim 16:8), etc.,
that immediately there will come to him

p: refers to the wisdom of the Written Torah,
which begins with the letter beis of "Bereishis,"
and from this branches out fear,
"From His right hand, a fiery law for them."
which is the wisdom of the Written Torah
for "the fallen fruit of the wisdom on High
of the Holy One, blessed be He,
from the side of His kindness, may He be blessed,
in that He gave us the Torah,
just as the creation of the world was
only from the side of His kindness, may He be blessed,
כִּי חָפֵץ חֶסֶד הוּא (מִיכָה ז, יח)
from which branches out the aspect of fear.
And the aspect of the letter hei, love,
דְּמִינֵּיהּ עָאל רְחִימָא דְּקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
from which the love of the Holy One, blessed be He, enters,
one who understands one thing from another;
it is the aspect of the Oral Torah,
brings the wisdom into his heart,
to produce understanding in the heart
whose root is from the understanding of the heart,
as our Sages, of blessed memory, said
concerning the scribes of the judges,
and likewise in the days of Yosei ben Yoezer,
that one produces through the heart
that is the essence of Torah.
the Rebbe of Izbitza, may the memory of the tzaddik be a blessing,
it means according to the measure of his heart;
that does not come out of the heart
is that from it judgments are aroused,
as our Sages, of blessed memory, said (Taanis 4a):
"A Torah scholar who boils with anger
it is the Torah that makes him boil,
And our Sages, of blessed memory, also said
אֵין אוּר שֶׁל גֵּיהִנֹּם שׁוֹלְטוֹת בּוֹ
the fire of Gehinnom has no power over them,
a fortiori from the salamander, etc.;
whose entire body is fire," etc.
the aspect of love and endearment,
from sensing the sweetness of the reasoning
that is renewed from within his heart;
for it is said of them (Tehillim 19:11):
And our Sages, of blessed memory, said
and to the one whom He loves,
a parable of a king, etc.;
and he gave him of the delicacies
This is the aspect of the Oral Torah.
the meal of the night of holy Shabbos
and the second meal, of the morning,
because the aspect of Avraham Avinu
who understands a matter from his own heart,
the aspect of the Oral Torah,
as our Sages, of blessed memory, said
אֶלָּא זִימֵּן לוֹ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
but the Holy One, blessed be He, provided him
and they would well forth Torah," etc.
the aspect of love and endearment,
and it corresponds to the letter hei,
Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him, however,
that is his father, who taught him wisdom;
and he is the aspect of yud, Chochmah,
is the meal of Shabbos night,
of the Field of Holy Apples,
that is, the collective souls of Yisrael
the aspect of "a woman who fears Hashem" (Mishlei 31:30).
מִינֵּיהּ יֵעוּל עַל פּוּמָא דְּבַר נָשׁ
from which there enters into a person's mouth
corresponds to drawing down the Tree of Life,
corresponds to the actual doing of the mitzvos,
that is, the six hundred thirteen counsels
onto the two hundred forty-eight limbs
and three hundred sixty-five sinews of a person,
through the actual doing of the mitzvos
throughout the six days of work;
and that is from the side of the servant.
And this is only in particular:
onto the soul from that mitzvah,
as with the mitzvah of charity,
which in the language of Chazal is called
However, through the holiness of Shabbos,
which is specifically the mitzvah of ceasing
from all the actual doing of the mitzvos,
in the totality of the ceasing,
in all the deeds of the mitzvos.
And this is "a good gift in My treasure house,"
the completion of all is in it," etc.
And this is the ultimate aspect of teshuvah on Shabbos:
"the hei shall return to the vav."
And this is the confession in words,
"It is good to thank Hashem," etc.
And it is known what our Sages, of blessed memory, said
that even for violations of a positive commandment,
although "he does not move from there
he is obligated to bring an olah offering,
And for this comes the holiness of Shabbos,
which is considered as a gift and an offering,
as our Sages, of blessed memory, said
about the meal of a Torah scholar,
that it is considered as an offering:
"Whoever wishes to pour a libation of wine
יְמַלֵּא גְּרוֹנָם שֶׁל תַּלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים יַיִן
should fill the throats of Torah scholars with wine" (Yoma 71a);
is as if he offered the daily offerings" (Berachos 10b);
and "one who brings a gift to a Torah scholar
is as if he offered first fruits" (Kesubos 105b).
"Is there anything more precious to us than it?"
everyone is like a Torah scholar,
and eating on Shabbos is like an offering,
as a gift to find favor;
